sources.title: UncertainPrinciple/titanic-model-v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Titanic Survival Predictor 🚢 This project is a simple AI application that predicts a passenger's survival chances on the Titanic based on their characteristics. The model was trained using scikit-learn and deployed on Hugging Face Spaces with Gradio.
